Amnestied as a pre-existing residency the audit MISSED. SPLIT PER LANE by the second sc-15799 review, which found the single both-lanes row UNDER-DECLARED candle. The two ports make independent dtype decisions and the ledger's uniqueness key is now (model, component, lane), so each lane states its own residentTier instead of one of them being wrong. Declaring bf16 for both would have under-declared candle; declaring f32 for both would have over-declared mlx. CANDLE lane: f32, because `fm_head` is widened by `quant::get_f32`. `embed_tokens` and `lm_head` ride the bf16 store dtype on this lane, so f32 is the component's UPPER resident precision — the tier the row must declare, since the invariant is one-directional about being ABOVE the selected tier. The mlx sibling row declares bf16.
